frontmatter.title: Automating Algorithm Discovery: A Case Study in MoE Load Balancing
frontmatter.author: Audrey Cheng, Bowen Wang, Shu Liu, Melissa Pan, Ion Stoica, ADRS Team
frontmatter.excerpt: This post is the first in a series of case studies in which we apply ADRS to optimize performance in various systems. We discuss the optimization of a key component in large language model (LLM) inference. Specifically, we demonstrate how OpenEvolve independently discovers and surpasses highly optimized algorithms engineered by human experts to achieve a 5.0x speedup.
